Relative to RGB by itself, the depth rendering makes the spatial layers of the projecting leaves, raised lip of the open plastic bag, and lifted right forearm against the dark-soil background much clearer. It remains unreliable within the bag, where the dark mulch appears as a level recess, and near the top of frames 2 and 5, where the far person's feet and the vehicle wheel merge with the dark background gradient.
